# Nondisclosure schedule: project descriptions

This schedule describes information covered by a draft nondisclosure agreement. It deliberately omits the parties' identities. The expressions below are titles of internal design projects, not names of companies, partnerships or other bodies.

- Copper Horizon: a folding display stand with replaceable hinges.
- Silver Orchard: a collection of colour samples for a proposed exhibition.
- Night Compass: a draft instruction booklet explaining assembly and packing.

Access to the materials is permitted only to evaluate a possible licence. The recipient must not distribute the drawings or use them to commission a competing prototype. The draft agreement does not require either side to enter a later supply contract.

The project title Copper Horizon should appear on the cover of its drawing set so that versions can be distinguished. Silver Orchard is a materials collection rather than a trading business. Night Compass remains an unpublished booklet and has no separate legal personality.

An evaluation period of forty-five days is proposed. The illustrative licence fee is GBP 2,500, and the suggested start date is 8 January 2027. Neither figure is a personal identifier. Section 5.3 concerns return of the drawings, while article 9 concerns permitted disclosures.

The signature blocks are intentionally empty in this circulation copy. No individual, private organisation, address or contact value is supplied. Completing a signature block requires a separate instruction; the project titles must not be entered as contracting parties.
